privacy.translation2: Only if you actively trigger a live translation under “More languages”, the visible text of the current page is sent to a translation service, which translates it with Anthropic's Claude API. The operator of the service also processes technically necessary connection data such as the IP address. No cookies are set and no data is stored permanently. Without your action, no request takes place.
